meta.title: Personal data policy
meta.description: How Kedrovnik processes and protects the personal data of site visitors: purposes, legal grounds, retention, rights and safeguards.

title: Personal data policy
demo: A demo document of a fictional company. It follows the structure required by Russian Federal Law No. 152-FZ “On Personal Data”, but has no legal force.

paragraphs.1: This policy sets out how {operator} (the operator) processes and protects the personal data it receives through the site and when working with customers.
paragraphs.2: The policy follows Federal Law No. 152-FZ of 27 July 2006 “On Personal Data” and is published for unrestricted access (Art. 18.1(2) of the law).
paragraphs.3: The operator processes personal data lawfully and fairly, only for purposes defined in advance and only to the extent those purposes require.
A person responsible for personal data processing has been appointed by order of the operator; write to them at {privacyEmail}.

paragraphs.1: Pricing the chosen house configuration, preparing a proposal and sending it to the email address given.
paragraphs.2: Handling the request: calling or writing back, advising, preparing a contract.
paragraphs.3: Concluding and performing a contract for manufacturing and assembling a house.
paragraphs.4: Protecting the site from abuse by limiting how often forms can be sent.

paragraphs.1: The data subject's consent, given by ticking the consent box in the request form (Art. 6(1)(1) of the law). The date and time of consent are stored with the request.
paragraphs.2: Concluding and performing a contract to which the data subject is a party (Art. 6(1)(5) of the law).
paragraphs.3: The operator's legitimate interest in protecting the site, provided the data subject's rights are not infringed (Art. 6(1)(7) of the law).

paragraphs.1: Visitors who send a request: name, phone number, email address, comment, the chosen house configuration and its price.
paragraphs.2: Contract customers: in addition, passport details and the plot address — only when a contract is concluded.
paragraphs.3: Technical data: an anonymised hash of the IP address used to rate-limit forms. No special categories of data and no biometric data are processed.

actions.title: What is done with the data

paragraphs.1: Collection, recording, organisation, accumulation, storage, correction, retrieval, use, transfer (provision, access), blocking, erasure and destruction.
paragraphs.2: Processing is mixed: automated in the operator's information system and manual when working with contracts.
paragraphs.3: Data is stored in databases located in the Russian Federation (Art. 18(5) of the law). No cross-border transfer takes place.

paragraphs.1: The operator may entrust processing to a party that runs its CRM system or sends its mail, under a contract that obliges them to keep the data confidential and protected (Art. 6(3) of the law).
paragraphs.2: Data is never sold or passed on for third-party advertising.

paragraphs.1: Requests: three years from the last contact, or until consent is withdrawn where consent was the only ground.
paragraphs.2: Contract data: for the period required by accounting and archiving law.
paragraphs.3: Copies of emails sent by the site are kept in the demo mailbox for {mailboxDays} days; the rate-limiting log for one day.
paragraphs.4: Once the purpose is achieved or consent is withdrawn, the data is destroyed within 30 days and a record of destruction is made.

paragraphs.1: To learn how their data is processed: by whom, how, why and for how long (Art. 14 of the law).
paragraphs.2: To have the data corrected, blocked or destroyed if it is incomplete, outdated, inaccurate or processed unlawfully.
paragraphs.3: To withdraw consent by writing to {privacyEmail}. Withdrawal does not affect processing carried out before it.
paragraphs.4: To appeal against the operator to Roskomnadzor or to a court.
paragraphs.5: The operator answers within 10 working days; the period may be extended by no more than 5 working days, with reasons given.

paragraphs.1: A person responsible for processing has been appointed, internal policies are in place, and internal audits and harm assessments are carried out (Art. 18.1 of the law).
paragraphs.2: Only sales staff can see requests, by role; content managers cannot. Every action in the system is taken under a personal account.
paragraphs.3: Data in transit is encrypted (HTTPS), passwords are stored as hashes, and backups are encrypted.
paragraphs.4: Links to proposals and to copies of emails cannot be guessed, and each opens exactly one document.

paragraphs.1: The site uses no advertising or analytics cookies. The browser keeps only the chosen colour theme; staff signing in to the CMS receive a session cookie.
Questions and requests about personal data: {privacyEmail}; postal address: {address}.
paragraphs.2: The operator may change this policy; a new version applies from its publication on this page.
